title: philadelphus microphyllus var. occidentalis
intro: Philadelphus microphyllus var. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Mock Orange, is a plant species native to North America, characterized by its fragrant white flowers and small leaves. The Western Mock Orange is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antiseptic and antioxidant, which may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Philadelphus microphyllus var. occidentalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
